The Seattle Mariners will be on the road, opening a three-game series against the Kansas City Royals on Friday, May 22 at 7:40 p.m. ET.

The Mariners are 23-24 in games they were favored on the moneyline (winning 48.9% of those games). This season, Seattle has been the underdog three times and won one of those games.
